mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_NAME AS userName, NICKNAME AS nickname, EMAIL AS email, PHONE AS phone, ZIPCODE AS zipcode, USER_ADDR AS userAddr, FULL_ADDR AS fullAddr, CDATE AS cdate FROM users WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET USER_NAME = #{userName}, NICKNAME = #{nickname}, EMAIL = #{email}, PHONE = #{phone}, ZIPCODE = #{zipcode}, USER_ADDR = #{userAddr}, FULL_ADDR = #{fullAddr} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT PET_NO AS petNo, USER_ID AS userId, PET_NAME AS petName, SPECIES AS species, BREED AS breed, BIRTHDATE AS birthdate, GENDER AS gender, IS_MAIN AS isMain FROM pet WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS_MAIN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, PET_NO DESC

SELECT PET_NO AS petNo, USER_ID AS userId, PET_NAME AS petName, SPECIES AS species, BREED AS breed, BIRTHDATE AS birthdate, GENDER AS gender, IS_MAIN AS isMain FROM pet WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PET_NO = #{petNo}
SELECT PET_NO AS petNo, USER_ID AS userId, PET_NAME AS petName FROM pet WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY PET_NO ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet ( USER_ID, PET_NAME, SPECIES, BREED, BIRTHDATE, GENDER, IS_MAIN ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{petName}, #{species}, #{breed}, #{birthdate}, #{gender}, #{isMain} )
mapper.select: SELECT RSV_NO AS rsvNo, RSV_DATE AS rsvDate, RSV_START_TIME AS rsvStartTime, RSV_END_TIME AS rsvEndTime, STORE_NO AS storeNo, PET_NO AS petNo, MENU_NO AS menuNo, REQUEST AS request, RSV_STATUS AS rsvStatus FROM reservation WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY RSV_DATE DESC, RSV_NO DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT RSV_NO AS rsvNo, RSV_DATE AS rsvDate, RSV_START_TIME AS rsvStartTime, RSV_END_TIME AS rsvEndTime, STORE_NO AS storeNo, PET_NO AS petNo, MENU_NO AS menuNo, REQUEST AS request, RSV_STATUS AS rsvStatus FROM reservation WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY RSV_DATE DESC, RSV_NO DESC

SELECT o.ORD_NO AS orderNo, o.ORD_DATE AS orderDate, o.ORD_STATUS AS orderStatus, o.TOTAL_PRICE AS totalPrice, o.DELI_STATUS AS deliStatus, o.ORD_ADDR AS address FROM orders o WHERE o.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY o.ORD_DATE DESC, o.ORD_NO DESC
